theme.title: The Answer's run
theme.subtitle: Philadelphia, 2000–01
theme.recap: An MVP guard, a midseason defensive anchor and two Game 7 battles took Philadelphia all the way to a hard-fought Finals.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Allen Iverson's 2000–01 76ers win?
questions.note: 56–26, giving the Sixers the top seed in the East.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers finished in first place in the Atlantic Division with a 56–26 record

funFacts.text: Philadelphia traded Theo Ratliff, Toni Kukoč and Nazr Mohammed to Atlanta for center Dikembe Mutombo during the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the team traded Theo Ratliff, Toni Kukoč, and Nazr Mohammed to the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for All-Star center Dikembe Mutombo

funFacts.text: Larry Brown was named NBA Coach of the Year as Philadelphia improved by seven wins over the previous season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Head coach Larry Brown was named the NBA Coach of the Year, after leading the 76ers to a seven-game improvement

funFacts.text: The Sixers changed the look of their white home and black road uniforms that season, including the lettering and collar design.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the 76ers slightly updated their white home uniforms and black road uniforms

questions.prompt: What was Allen Iverson's scoring average during his 2000–01 MVP season?
questions.note: 31.1 a night, enough to lead the league and win MVP.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: All-Star guard Allen Iverson averaged 31.1 points, 4.6 assists and 2.5 steals per game

funFacts.text: Iverson led the NBA not only in scoring but also in steals that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: leading the league in both scoring and steals

funFacts.text: Iverson also won All-Star Game MVP in Washington, D.C., where the East beat the West by a single point.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Iverson scored 25 points along with 5 assists and 4 steals, and was named the All-Star Game Most Valuable Player

funFacts.text: Philadelphia had an unusual awards sweep: teammate Aaron McKie was Sixth Man of the Year and Mutombo was Defensive Player of the Year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Aaron McKie provided the team with 11.6 points, 5.0 assists and 1.4 steals per game, and was named the NBA Sixth Man of the Year

questions.prompt: How many games did the 2000–01 Sixers win in a row to start the season?
questions.note: Ten straight wins before their first loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers won their first ten games of the regular season

funFacts.text: Philadelphia had built a 36–14 record by the All-Star break before its midseason roster overhaul.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: later on held a 36–14 record at the All-Star break

funFacts.text: Starting guard Eric Snow missed a large chunk of the season with a stress fracture in his right ankle.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: only played just 50 games due to a stress fracture in his right ankle

funFacts.text: The Sixers reached a 42–14 record at one point but went 14–12 over the rest of the regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: At one point, the team's record was 42–14, but finished 14–12 the rest of the way

questions.prompt: What was Dikembe Mutombo's rebounding average after joining the 2000–01 Sixers?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Mutombo averaged 11.7 points, 12.4 rebounds and 2.5 blocks per game in 26 games after the trade

funFacts.text: Mutombo won Defensive Player of the Year for the fourth time in his career that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: and was named the NBA Defensive Player of the Year for the fourth time

funFacts.text: The trade was partly driven by a season-ending wrist injury to Theo Ratliff, who had previously been the Sixers' starting center.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: prior to the trade, Ratliff was sidelined due to a season-ending wrist injury

funFacts.text: During his short Philadelphia regular-season stint, Mutombo also averaged 2.5 blocks a game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Mutombo averaged 11.7 points, 12.4 rebounds and 2.5 blocks per game in 26 games after the trade

questions.prompt: How many points did the 76ers score in their overtime Game 1 win over the Lakers in 2001?
questions.context: 2001 NBA Finals · June 6 · Philadelphia at Los Angeles
questions.note: 107, the Lakers' only defeat during that postseason.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: June 6 @ L.A. Lakers W 107–101 (OT)

funFacts.text: That opening-game overtime win was the Lakers' only loss across their entire 2001 playoff run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: By the end of the series, the 2000–01 Lakers held the record for the best postseason record with 15–1.

funFacts.text: Philadelphia outscored Los Angeles 13–7 in overtime after a close regulation contest.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Scoring by quarter: 22–23, 34–27, 23–27, 15–17, Overtime: 13–7

funFacts.text: The Sixers had just survived two straight seven-game playoff series against Toronto and Milwaukee before reaching the Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: had just come out of two straight seven-game series against the Toronto Raptors and Milwaukee Bucks
